events.title: 사우샘프턴 cause a major shock by beating 맨체스터 유나이티드 1–0 in the FA Cup final thanks to a second-half goal from Bobby Stokes . They emulate 선덜랜드's 1973 feat of winning the Cup from the Second Division.

리버풀 come from a goal down to beat 울버햄프턴 원더러스 3–1 and win the League title. They finish a point ahead of 퀸스 파크 레인저스 and four ahead of 맨체스터 유나이티드. The defeat condemns 울버햄프턴 원더러스 to relegation alongside 셰필드 유나이티드 and 번리.
웨스트햄 유나이티드 lose 4–2 to 안더레흐트 in the European Cup Winners' Cup final at the Heysel Stadium in Brussels .
England lose 2–1 to Scotland at Hampden Park in their last Home Championship match. 케니 달글리시 scores the winning goal when his shot goes between the legs of England goalkeeper Ray Clemence .
리버풀 claim their second European trophy by drawing 1–1 with Club Bruges to complete a 4–3 aggregate victory in the UEFA Cup final.
England come from two goals down at half-time to beat Italy 3–2 in New 요크 시티 in a tournament organised to commemorate the bicentenary of the independence of the USA .
